entities.name: Scythian Civilization
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Nomadic warrior-pastoralists who dominated the Eurasian steppe from the 8th to 3rd centuries BCE, ranging from the Black Sea to Siberia. The Scythians' mastery of mounted archery, elaborate gold artwork (animal style), and trade networks connecting Greece to China made them the most powerful nomadic civilization of the ancient world.
